summary: This bill expresses Congress's support for open water lifeguards, reaffirming their classification as first responders and emergency response providers due to their essential, lifesaving work.

scores.thoughts: This resolution expresses support for open water lifeguards and reaffirms their status as first responders. While it touches on their work conditions and recognition, it does not propose any new labor laws, union rights, or changes to employer flexibility, making its impact on labor and unions very indirect and minor.
